retentionIntegrity.note: runtime_events is trimmed to STORAGE_ROW_CAPS by storageCapacityGuard.maintainBounds(); the caps bound how far back history reaches, so a gap in this window cannot be a trim artefact (trimming deletes the oldest rows only).
retentionIntegrity.conclusion: non-critical history reaches back before the window start, so per-type counts inside this window are complete rather than lower bounds

samplingLoopLiveness.method: two /health reads 20s apart; the shadow sampler counter and sample timestamp only advance while the engine timers run
samplingLoopLiveness.conclusion: sampling loop advanced between reads: the engine timer loop is alive during the AI silence
